notes.title: Today is April fools day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36610663/128363bd8536d5b51a4ef9ae4b6fed47507d628a.png[/img]

[h2]Try out the new UI (feedback wanted)[/h2]

The new and proper UI is here along with new background, to match the style of character illustrations.

[list]
[*] Pop, round and soft look
[*] Many playful animations
[*] New settings and results screen, designed from scratch
[/list]

This is the first trial version and we welcome all feedback. Feel free to say hi to us on our Discord server!

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new limited-time map. Only available during April 1-7! Let's learn Japanese together!
[*] Fixed a problem where judge offset didn't work on some Secret maps.
[/list]



ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
Stay tuned for more functional updates!
Halo Beats! Team

added songs in this update.

We are planning to add functions and fix bugs so you can enjoy the game even more in the future.
